_: Parking signs that nobody can read in the photograph - too far away, too small. They are parking signs, so they do not belong in triage_expected.json, which lists photographs that are not; and there is nothing to read, so they can have no ground-truth reading either. The right answer is a refusal, and it counts whichever way the product refuses: triage turning the photograph away, or a reading graded insufficient, with no window drawn (decision 176).
